messages.subject: Betagro | Food systems, sustainability and stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear Betagro Leadership Team,

Betagro's integrated food business and sustainability commitments align closely with my experience leading ESG, institutional engagement and cross-functional execution.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities cover government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy.

I manage regulator interfaces, community priorities, compliance commitments and strategic stakeholder relationships across a major industrial operation. My recent work also includes renewable-energy and carbon-governance initiatives, giving me a broad responsible-business perspective.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional responsibilities in Sustainability, Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships or country leadership. I have attached a Betagro-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
